description.value: Little Caesar's is a well-known Canadian pizza chain offering hot-and-ready pizzas for carryout and delivery. This Nanaimo location (unit 3) is part of the globally recognized franchise founded in Michigan in 1959. For a touring cyclist looking for a quick, filling meal, it offers an accessible fast-food option in the Nanaimo area.
